title_sq: Shitet apartament 3+1+2 + post parkimi te perfshire ne cmim tek Mine Peza!
description_sq:
Apartamenti organizohet nga nje korridor i cili bene shperndarjen ne dhoma , nje sallon me kuzhine te perbashket , tre dhoma gjumi , dy tualete si dhe dy ballkone . Ka nje siperfaqe neto 125 me dhe 152 m2 bruto .
Dy dhomat e gjumit shohin nga brenda Rezidences ndersa salloni dhe dhoma e gjumit matrimoniale shohin nga Perendimi.
Apartamenti perfshin nje Post Parkimi ne cmim dhe administrimin per dy vite.
Per nje vizite ne prone ose me shume informacion na kontaktoni!
title_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale + parking space included in the price in Mine Peza!
description_en: The apartment is organized by a corridor that divides the rooms, a living room with a common kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and two balconies. It has a net surface of 125 m and 152 m2 gross. The two bedrooms look inside the Residence, while the living room and the master bedroom look west. The apartment includes a Parking Post in the price and administration for two years. For a visit to the property or more information, contact us!
